title: Moruga Heritage & Recreation Tour
summary: A full-day National Trust trip visits cocoa heritage, historic landmarks and the Moruga coast.
description: The National Trust of Trinidad and Tobago lists this full-day Moruga tour for Saturday, October 10, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Stops include the Cocoa and Chocolate Museum, the ruins of Mother Corn Husk Chapel and Home, Spring Bridge, Moruga Beach Facility, and St. Vincent Ferrer RC Church. The non-member price is TT$350; members pay TT$300. Lunch is optional for an additional TT$60. Contact the organizer to confirm transport, meeting point and availability.
